certification.name: GRC Auditor
certification.description: Certification on auditing governance, risk and compliance capabilities. Online open-book exam of 100 scored multiple-choice questions in 120 minutes with a pass mark of 70; it renews yearly with the membership and 8 CPE credits from the second year.
certification.currency_note: No separate exam fee; the exam, retakes and maintenance are included in the paid OCEG All Access Pass membership
